summary: Known-good run-level evidence combining discovery, reachability, patch scoring, evidence packets, tests, approvals, residual risk, and reproducibility.

evidence: Detected all selected reachable findings for JS-XSS-001, NODE-SSRF-001, and TS-TELEMETRY-NET-001.
Reachable fixtures were distinguished from unreachable/safe paired fixtures.
False-positive boundaries were cited in the evidence packets.
Plans removed the vulnerable behavior with minimal compatibility impact.
Follow-up risks were called out where compatibility review was needed.
Candidate repair suite passed the curated candidate-repair smoke packet.
Patch-diff results were retained under ignored scoring outputs.
Non-CVE evidence packet suite passed the positive packet and rejected negative controls.
Quality dimensions were present for required cases.
Each case included exploit rejection and compatibility-preservation tests.
Safe harnesses passed without real exploit execution or outbound network calls.
Human approval gates were documented for security, compatibility, and rollout decisions.
Residual risk was explicitly reported or rejected per case.
Validation commands, scorer commands, input packets, and generated output locations were documented.
Generated result JSON remained ignored and reproducible.
